items.review_rationale: Reviewed clopen-subset equivalent characterization of connectedness over arbitrary topological space, including empty-space convention and requiring only trivial clopen subsets.

references.context: C belongs to the topology and its complement X minus C also belongs to that topology.

references.phrase: trivial clopen choices empty or X
references.context: Every simultaneously open-and-closed subset must be one of the two extremal sets.

references.disposition: This clopen condition defines the same connectedness meaning; no self-reference to separation formulation.
For empty X the only subset is empty, which equals X, making condition true.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed left group action as map from G times X to X respecting group identity and multiplication by nested evaluations; no right-action reversal and no free-action assumption.

references.phrase: mapping alpha:G times X to X

references.context: Identity group element fixes each point of acted-on set.
Successive action by h and then g equals left action by product gh.

references.disposition: Action is on left with product gh matching order of function composition.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed metric outer measure as outer measure on entire power set of nonempty metric space, additive for subsets strictly positively separated by set distance; empty-set infimum convention preserved.

references.phrase: subsets A and B of X

references.context: Infimum of pairwise metric distances for a in A and b in B.

references.phrase: positive separation of A and B
references.context: Infimum pair distance is strictly greater than zero.
For positively separated sets, outer measure of their union equals the sum of their measures.
By convention set distance is +infty when one input set is empty.

references.phrase: metric additivity not full countable additivity
references.disposition: Additivity required only for separated sets, on top of all ordinary outer-measure axioms.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed outer measure as extended-nonnegative set function on every subset, with empty-set normalization, inclusion monotonicity and countable subadditivity over arbitrary sequences, not countable additivity.

references.phrase: mapping from P(X) into extended nonnegative reals
nonnegative integers or positive countable sequence indices

references.context: Collection of all subsets of X, domain of the outer-measure function.
Values are real numbers at least zero together with formal +infinity.
Normalization of mass of empty subset.

references.phrase: monotonicity A subseteq B implies mu*(A)<=mu*(B)
references.context: Outer measure respects set inclusion by nondecreasing assigned size.
Measure of union of countably many arbitrary subsets is at most sum of individual outer measures.

references.disposition: No measurable-set domain restriction or countable exact-additivity claim imposed.
